title: Assessment of Relation Between Recurrence of Enterocutaneous Fistula and Preoperative C-reactive Protein Level After Complete Surgical Repair
brief_summary: A prospective study of 40 patients admitted with the diagnosis of enterocutaneous fistula and prepared for definite surgical repair in the form of resection anastomosis of ECF. The investigators used preoperative serum C-reactive protein as predicting factor to recurrence and independent variable for timing of surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with ECF were included in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cases submitted for surgical treatment with protecting stoma or terminal were excluded from our study. Other fistulas like perianal, pancreatic, biliary and internal fistulas were not involved due to their different nature, treatment and prognosis
